summary: Upgrade inventory variables for the 2.4 single controller to 2.6 growth topology: registry credentials, redis_mode=standalone, automationgateway_admin_password and pg settings, controller admin_password and pg_host, and admin and database passwords for hub and Event-Driven Ansible.
questions: What variables are needed to upgrade AAP 2.4 to 2.6 growth?
What redis_mode should a growth topology use?
Which gateway variables are new in 2.6?

answer_card.title: New variables for a 2.6 growth upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
redis_mode=standalone

automationgateway_admin_password=<set your own>
automationgateway_pg_host=db.example.org
automationgateway_pg_password=<set your own>

automationhub_admin_password=<set your own>
automationhub_pg_host=db.example.org
automationhub_pg_password=<set your own>

automationedacontroller_admin_password=<set your own>
automationedacontroller_pg_host=db.example.org
automationedacontroller_pg_password=<set your own>
```

Keep `registry_username`, `registry_password`, `admin_password`, `pg_host` and `pg_password` from the 2.4 inventory.
